- `GET /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/forms` — The tenant's forms, newest first
- `POST /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/forms` — Create a form: its name, fields of the catalogue and credentials to present
- `GET /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/forms/{form_id}` — One form
- `PUT /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/forms/{form_id}` — Change a form: the whole of it, as when it was created
- `DELETE /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/forms/{form_id}` — Delete a form no offer puts and nothing was made with
- `GET /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/forms/{form_id}/schema` — The JSON Schema its answers meet
- `GET /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/forms/{form_id}/dcql` — The OpenID4VP DCQL query of the credentials it asks for
- `POST /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/forms/{form_id}/verify` — Verify the credentials presented for a form (an OpenID4VP vp_token)

## Create a form: its name, fields of the catalogue and credentials to present

`POST /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/forms` · needs `Authorization: Bearer`

| Parameter | In | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tenant_id` | path | string (uuid) |  |

**Body** (`application/json`): [FormIn](/reference/api/schemas/#formin)

| Field | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | map of string |  |
| `description` *(optional)* | map of string or null |  |
| `fields` *(optional)* | array of [FormField](/reference/api/schemas/#formfield) | at most 100 |
| `credentials` *(optional)* | array of [CredentialRequest](/reference/api/schemas/#credentialrequest) | at most 20 |

| Status | Answer |
| --- | --- |
| 201 | [FormOut](/reference/api/schemas/#formout) |
| 422 | [`fields_required`](/reference/errors/#fields_required) (no field nor credential), [`field_unknown`](/reference/errors/#field_unknown), [`field_rename_invalid`](/reference/errors/#field_rename_invalid), [`field_key_invalid`](/reference/errors/#field_key_invalid), [`field_key_duplicate`](/reference/errors/#field_key_duplicate), [`field_narrow_invalid`](/reference/errors/#field_narrow_invalid), [`credential_unknown`](/reference/errors/#credential_unknown), [`credential_key_invalid`](/reference/errors/#credential_key_invalid), [`credential_key_duplicate`](/reference/errors/#credential_key_duplicate), [`credential_type_duplicate`](/reference/errors/#credential_type_duplicate), [`credential_claims_invalid`](/reference/errors/#credential_claims_invalid), [`credential_trust_invalid`](/reference/errors/#credential_trust_invalid) or [`language_not_enabled`](/reference/errors/#language_not_enabled) (a text in a language the tenant does not work in); one about a field or a credential says which beside the code: `field` or `credential`, its index in the list |

## Change a form: the whole of it, as when it was created

`PUT /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/forms/{form_id}` · needs `Authorization: Bearer`

| Parameter | In | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `form_id` | path | string (uuid) |  |
| `tenant_id` | path | string (uuid) |  |

**Body** (`application/json`): [FormIn](/reference/api/schemas/#formin)

| Field | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | map of string |  |
| `description` *(optional)* | map of string or null |  |
| `fields` *(optional)* | array of [FormField](/reference/api/schemas/#formfield) | at most 100 |
| `credentials` *(optional)* | array of [CredentialRequest](/reference/api/schemas/#credentialrequest) | at most 20 |

| Status | Answer |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | [FormOut](/reference/api/schemas/#formout) |
| 404 | [`form_not_found`](/reference/errors/#form_not_found) |
| 409 | [`form_in_use`](/reference/errors/#form_in_use): in use, it may only take more than it took; with `field` or `credential` beside the code when one of them says why |
| 422 | As creating it |
